benchmark_kind: executed verification of the owner-blind pooling circuit
protocol: MP-SPDZ Semi, three local parties. Threat model unchanged: any two of three servers may collude. No dealer, no trusted setup, no FSS.
scope_warning: Eight key blocks of two values, on a single host. This verifies the MECHANISM, not federation-scale performance; the remap here is a direct oblivious scan, whereas at scale it becomes the sort-join measured in sort_join_growth.json. All three parties ran on one machine, which does not instantiate the non-collusion assumption. Passive protocol only.
what_was_verified: That the pooling mechanism works end to end in MPC: the pooled array is permuted under a secret permutation the servers never learn, every descriptor is remapped through a parallel position array, and every key still reads back its own data.

construction.row_is_a_whole_key_block: Each row holds one key's entire page block, so shuffling ROWS moves a key's pages atomically and the (base, count) descriptor stays addressable. Shuffling individual pages would split multi-page keys.
construction.one_permutation_two_arrays: A single shuffle handle is applied forward to the pool and in reverse to an identity array, yielding new_slot_of[p] = where original row p landed. The permutation exists only as a handle and is never opened.
construction.remap: Each descriptor's old row is looked up in new_slot_of. At federation scale this lookup is the sort-join; the mechanism is identical, only the lookup implementation differs.

executed_result.note: The permutation was opened here ONLY by the verification variant, so the test could confirm it is not the identity. The production circuit never reveals it, and a unit test enforces that.

status_change: Owner-blind pooling was a design with a cost model. It is now a mechanism that has been executed and verified in MPC. What remains is scale and integration, not feasibility.
remaining: Only run at eight key blocks; no federation-scale execution.
The remap is a direct oblivious scan here; the sort-join that makes it affordable at scale is measured but not implemented in the circuit.
Not integrated with the relation-paged backend.
No real dataset, WAN, or multi-host run.
